section: Nevada corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax
value: None: Nevada has no corporate income tax
note: Nevada also has no franchise tax; larger businesses pay the Commerce Tax on gross revenue instead.
source_title: Nevada Governor's Office of Economic Development: Doing Business In Nevada

section: Nevada corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Commerce Tax threshold (Nevada gross revenue per fiscal year)
note: Tax on Nevada gross revenue above $4 million per July-June fiscal year; rates vary by industry (NAICS category). Businesses below the threshold are exempt.
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Commerce Tax

label: Levied by
value: School districts, counties, cities, towns, special districts and the State
note: Rates are certified each year by the Nevada Tax Commission; assessed value is 35% of taxable value.
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Property Tax Rates for Nevada Local Governments, FY 2026-2027 (certified June 25, 2026)

label: State oversight
value: Nevada Department of Taxation, Division of Local Government Services (Locally Assessed Properties Section)
note: Oversees county assessors through ratio studies and values interstate and inter-county property.
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Property Tax

label: Property tax rate limit
value: $5.00 per $100 of assessed value (constitution); $3.64 per $100 (statute, NRS 361.453)
note: The State's 2-cent levy for capital projects and conservation sits outside the $3.64 cap.
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Property Tax Rates for Nevada Local Governments, FY 2026-2027 (certified June 25, 2026)

label: Annual tax bill increase cap for owner-occupied homes
note: Partial abatement: a primary residence's tax bill cannot rise more than 3% a year (or a lower county general abatement factor). Other property has a county-specific cap.
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Nevada Property Tax: Elements and Application (2024)

label: State property tax rate
value: $0.17 per $100 of assessed value (15 cents plus a 2-cent levy outside the cap), FY 2026-27
note: State levy for debt service on capital projects ($0.0118 of the 2 cents) and natural-resource conservation ($0.0082), per SB 502 (2025).
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Property Tax Rates for Nevada Local Governments, FY 2026-2027 (certified June 25, 2026)

label: Real Property Transfer Tax (state base rate)
value: $1.95 per $500 of value (or fraction), on transfers valued over $100
note: Collected by the county recorder when the deed is recorded, based on the Declaration of Value.
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Real Property Transfer Tax

label: Additional county rates
value: Clark County +$0.60 per $500 (total $2.55); Washoe and Churchill counties +$0.10 per $500 (total $2.05)
note: Added on top of the $1.95 base rate.
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Real Property Transfer Tax

label: Main exemptions
value: 14 statutory exemptions (NRS 375.090), e.g. transfers to government, between close relatives, between former spouses under a divorce decree, to or from a trust without consideration
note: The county recorder decides whether an exemption applies.
source_title: Nevada Department of Taxation: Real Property Transfer Tax
